map.计算校正血钙、钙磷乘积，评估CKD-MBD及血管钙化风险: Compute corrected serum calcium and the calcium-phosphorus product, and assess CKD-MBD and vascular calcification risk
map.核心计算公式（按输入变量）：calcium+0.02×(40-albumin)；: Core calculation formula (by input variables): calcium+0.02×(40-albumin); caP×12.4
map.换算：钙磷乘积 mmol²/L² × 12.45 = mg²/dL²。目标值<5: Conversion: calcium-phosphorus product in mmol²/L² × 12.45 = mg²/dL². Target <55 mg²/dL² (4.4 mmol²/L²).
map.提示：校正血钙公式 = 测得钙 + 0.02 × (40 - 白蛋白)。高钙磷乘: Note: corrected calcium = measured calcium + 0.02 × (40 − albumin). A high calcium-phosphorus product is an independent risk factor for vascular calcification and death. Lowering serum phosphorus is the priority strategy in managing CKD-MBD. This tool is for learning reference only.
map.校正钙 2.2(白蛋白 40)，Ca×P=3.52 mmol²/L²×12.4=: Corrected calcium 2.2 (albumin 40), Ca×P=3.52 mmol²/L²×12.4=43.6 mg²/dL²: <55 meets the target (dialysis goal).
map.血磷>1.78(透析)或>1.45(非透析)：需限磷饮食+磷结合剂，iPTH 同: Serum phosphorus >1.78 (dialysis) or >1.45 (non-dialysis): a phosphate-restricted diet plus phosphate binders is needed, with iPTH assessed at the same time.
map.低白蛋白时测钙偏低，按 40−白蛋白 校正更接近游离钙。: With low albumin, measured calcium reads low; correcting by 40 − albumin brings it closer to ionized calcium.
map.透析患者 Ca×P<55 mg²/dL²，降低血管钙化风险。: In dialysis patients Ca×P<55 mg²/dL², to reduce the risk of vascular calcification.
map.钙磷乘积(Ca×P)目标值评估器，根据校正血钙和血磷计算钙磷乘积，评估CKD-M: Calcium-phosphorus product (Ca×P) target assessor: computes the calcium-phosphorus product from corrected serum calcium and serum phosphorus to assess vascular calcification risk in CKD-MBD patients. A professional medical tool based on authoritative medical standards, for reference only.
